title: RoadsideAttempt
description: What the first professional on scene tried, and what came of it. More than a boolean, because the next party needs to know what has already been ruled out. The recoveryRequirements block uses the same field names as RecoveryJob.requirements, so the observation made at the roadside becomes the requirement of the recovery job without being retyped. Held in the vehicle eVault alongside the incident.

incidentEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the Incident the attempt was made for

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle that was attended

recordedByEName.description: eName of the named mechanic who attended. Attribution is to the person, not only to the organisation.

recordedByOrgEName.description: eName of the organisation the mechanic works for

arrivedAt.description: When the mechanic arrived at the vehicle

completedAt.description: When the attempt ended, fixed or not

attempted.description: What was tried on site, one entry per action

outcome.description: notFixed is what publishes the cannotFixOnSite status and starts the recovery, transport and mobility branches simultaneously

diagnosis.description: What the mechanic found wrong with the vehicle

suspectedCause.description: What probably caused the fault, where it differs from the diagnosis

recoveryRequirements.description: Observed on site. Consumed unchanged as RecoveryJob.requirements.

weightKg.description: Weight of the vehicle as found, load included, in kilograms

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain as found on site. It decides how the vehicle may be towed and stored.

wheelsTurn.description: Whether all wheels still turn freely

winchable.description: Whether the vehicle can be winched onto a flatbed

towingMethod.description: The towing method the mechanic says the vehicle needs

equipmentNeeded.description: Equipment the recovery must bring, such as dollies or a crane

certificationsRequired.description: Certifications the recovery crew must hold, such as for high-voltage electric vehicles

accessConstraints.description: What makes the vehicle hard to reach, such as a ditch, a car park height limit or a narrow road

mediaUris.description: w3ds://file URIs recorded during the attempt

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
